name: Motion tokens + global reduced-motion
description: Duration, easing (incl. linear() spring), distance and stagger tokens plus a global reduced-motion override; load first so every animation shares one rhythm.
reduced_motion: Distances, scale and stagger collapse to 0; slow durations capped at 200ms; smooth scroll off

name: Reveal on scroll, once (IntersectionObserver + CSS)
tags: reveal|reveal once|fade|fade up|entrance|scroll animation|on scroll|appear|animate on scroll|aos|intersection observer
description: Default section entrance: blocks fade and rise the first time they enter the viewport and never replay; hidden only behind an inline-script reveal-ready gate with a timeout, so no-JS visitors and screenshot tools never see blank content.
reduced_motion: Gate never opens; nothing hidden and nothing moves

name: Reveal-once observer (shared driver)
description: IntersectionObserver driver for reveal-on-scroll.css and image-reveal-clip.css: adds .is-revealed once then unobserves, staggers [data-reveal-group] children, and reveals everything before print.
reduced_motion: Removes the reveal-ready gate and exits; content visible and static

name: Staggered entrance
description: Children of a group fade up one after another (capped at 8) to show they belong together and their reading order; manual mode for menus and loaded results.
reduced_motion: On load: no animation. Manual mode: one short fade together, no travel

name: Hero page-load sequence
description: Choreographed first paint: headline lines rise from a mask, then lede, CTA and media settle, establishing hierarchy in about 1.1s without hurting LCP.
reduced_motion: No sequence; hero is static on first paint

name: Same-document View Transition helper
description: Wraps a DOM update in document.startViewTransition (with types when supported) so shared elements morph between states; pair with view-transition.css.
reduced_motion: Update runs instantly without starting a transition

name: View Transition styles (fade, morph, directional)
description: Shared ::view-transition-* styles: quiet root cross-fade, morph timing, forward/back slides via transition types, anchored header, reduced-motion zeroing.
reduced_motion: All view-transition animation durations set to 0s

name: Cross-document View Transitions (MPA)
description: Opt-in @view-transition { navigation: auto } for multi-page sites so same-origin navigations cross-fade and named elements morph with zero JS.
reduced_motion: Opt-in is scoped to no-preference; navigations are instant

name: SPA page transition (Motion AnimatePresence)
tags: page transition|route transition|animatepresence|exit animation|framer motion|react router
description: Route-keyed AnimatePresence with a fast exit and gentle enter, reducedMotion="user", and focus moved to the new h1 for keyboard users.
reduced_motion: Motion drops transform animations; opacity cross-fade remains

name: React ViewTransition (shared element + route slides)
description: React 19.3 <ViewTransition> patterns: named shared-element morph, per-page directional slides keyed by transition type, and addTransitionType for non-router changes.
reduced_motion: view-transition.css zeroes durations; routes swap instantly

name: Pinned horizontal scroll (GSAP ScrollTrigger)
description: Pins a section and scrubs a row of panels sideways on vertical scroll for process or story sequences, built only for wide screens with motion allowed.
reduced_motion: No pin; track becomes a native horizontal scroller with scroll-snap

name: Lenis smooth scroll + GSAP ticker sync
description: Eased wheel scrolling for scroll-storytelling pages, driven by the GSAP ticker when ScrollTrigger is present; keeps native scroll semantics.
reduced_motion: Not started; native scrolling is used

name: Pausable marquee / logo ticker
description: Seamless CSS loop for logos or quotes that pauses on hover, focus, off-screen and via a Pause button (WCAG 2.2.2); use marquee.js for the toggle and inert duplicate.
reduced_motion: No animation; duplicate hidden and items wrap into a static row

name: Split-text word reveal
tags: split text|text reveal|word animation|headline animation|mask reveal|kinetic type|splittext
description: Splits one display heading into masked words that rise in reading order when scrolled into view, keeping the original text for screen readers; needs text-split-reveal.css.
reduced_motion: Text is never split; nothing moves

name: Magnetic CTA button
description: Primary CTA leans toward the pointer (max 12px, transform-only) and eases back with Element.animate; one per page.
reduced_motion: Disabled; also disabled on touch / no-hover devices

name: Spotlight / cursor glow card
description: A radial glow follows the pointer across a card via --mx/--my set by spotlight-card.js (one delegated listener); fades in on hover or focus-within.
reduced_motion: Glow still tracks the pointer but appears without a fade

name: Number count-up
description: Counts key stats up to their final value (Intl-formatted, ease-out expo) when scrolled into view; final value is in the HTML and read once by screen readers. Uses rAF, not WAAPI.
reduced_motion: No counting; the final number written in HTML is shown

name: Accordion height animation (details / grid rows)
description: Opens disclosures smoothly: native <details> with ::details-content + interpolate-size, or a grid-template-rows 0fr to 1fr collapse for custom panels.
reduced_motion: Transitions removed; panels open instantly

name: Sliding tab indicator (FLIP)
description: One indicator glides between tabs using translateX + scaleX measured FLIP-style and animated with WAAPI, re-measured on resize without animating.
reduced_motion: Indicator jumps to the selected tab

name: Sliding tab indicator (Motion layoutId)
description: Segmented tabs whose active pill travels between buttons with a Motion layoutId spring (transform-based layout animation).
reduced_motion: reducedMotion="user" disables layout animation; pill jumps

name: Subtle parallax layer (scroll-driven)
description: Decorative image layer drifts at most +/-8% of its height against the content as the section crosses the viewport, clipped by its frame.
reduced_motion: No drift; layer is static

name: Skeleton shimmer
description: Loading placeholders that reserve the final layout, with a transform-based highlight sweep instead of background-position repaints.
reduced_motion: Sweep removed; static placeholder

name: In-view stagger (Motion, vanilla JS)
description: Uses Motion animate + inView + stagger to bring a group in once as it scrolls into view; items are hidden by JS only, so failures leave content visible.
reduced_motion: Nothing hidden or animated

name: Scroll-scrubbed reveal (tied to scroll position)
description: Entrance mapped to scroll position with animation-timeline: view(), so it plays forward and reverses with the scrollbar; for deliberate scroll-story moments, not ordinary section entrances.
reduced_motion: No hidden state and no movement; content is static

name: SVG line draw on scroll
description: An SVG path, route or chart line draws as its section scrolls through (pathLength=1 + stroke-dashoffset on a view timeline), with a draw-once mode for data charts, a clip-path wipe mode, and an IO + rAF fallback in draw-on-scroll.js.
reduced_motion: Line shown fully drawn; nothing animates

name: Reading progress bar (scroll timeline)
tags: progress bar|reading progress|scroll indicator|scroll timeline|article|long read|top bar
description: Thin fixed bar at the top that grows with scaleX on the root scroll() timeline to show how far through a long page the reader is; scroll-progress-bar.js covers engines without scroll timelines.
reduced_motion: Still tracks position via the JS driver (moves only with user scroll); no CSS animation runs

name: Sticky stacking cards
tags: sticky|stack|stacking cards|card stack|process steps|chapters|position sticky|scroll cards
description: Process or chapter cards pin below the header with position: sticky and the next one slides over, while the covered card recedes to scale 0.92 on a named view timeline (transform only).
duration_ms: scroll-linked (one slice of the list per card)
reduced_motion: Cards still stick and stack; no scaling

name: Image clip-path reveal
description: Key photos or videos are uncovered once by a clip-path inset wipe (up, left or from center) while the image settles from a slight zoom; driven by reveal-on-scroll.js behind the reveal-ready gate.
reduced_motion: No clip and no zoom; media visible immediately

name: Smooth anchor scrolling with sticky-header offset
tags: anchor|in-page link|scroll-behavior|scroll-margin|sticky header offset|jump link|table of contents|nav link
description: Native scroll-behavior: smooth for in-page links, enabled only without reduced motion, plus scroll-margin so targets land below a sticky header; no library.
reduced_motion: Anchor jumps are instant; offset still applies

name: Dialog + popover enter/exit (@starting-style)
description: Native <dialog> and popover open with a short rise-and-fade and close faster, using @starting-style plus display/overlay transitions with allow-discrete; the backdrop dims in step. No JS animation code.
reduced_motion: Opacity fade only; no travel or scale
